definitions: To form letters, words, or symbols on a surface with a pen, pencil, or other implement.
To compose and set down in written form (e.g., a book, letter, or song).
To communicate or express something in writing.
To be the author or composer of (a book, article, piece of music, etc.).
To send a letter or email to someone.
examples: I will write to you next week.
The band wrote a new song.
